Make every mile a moment of comfort! Our Car Back Seat Inflatable Air Mattress Bed is a must-have for road warriors. Perfect for hiking, camping, or simply relaxing on the go. Where will your comfort take you? 🌍🚙

✅ Portable
✅ Inflatable 
✅ Available in black, blue and beige 
✅ Universal for backseats of all cars

📦 Box includes
✅ 2 pillows
✅ 1 mattress + support
✅ Complimentary bag
✅ Mattress repair kit (in case of later damage)
✅ 1 air pump (to be connected with car's 12V socket, comes with 1.8 meters long cord)

📦 FREE Shipping across Pakistan

P.S. Once you place the order, our representative will call you to confirm your choice of the mattress color.
